shortDescription: Asking prices for oil from Russia’s Pacific coast are rising as Chinese refiners snap up spot cargoes and their supply options narrow, according to Bloomberg. Traders said the buying has tightened available alternatives for Chinese refiners.

title: Russian Pacific Oil Asking Prices Surge as Chinese Refiners Buy Spot Cargoes
